Subject: Re: Quick ask — temporary capacity top-up and co-term options

Hi Anna — thanks for the data, that helps. Quick summary of options for the 3-month window:

1) Short-term top-up (on-demand pool): immediate capacity, billed at standard overage rates. Fastest to stand up, minimal paperwork, but per-token unit cost is higher.

2) Blended pilot (recommended): 3-month committed top-up with a modest discount (tiered) and a defined seat of reserved capacity. We can offer a blended pilot price that reduces unit cost vs on-demand and provides predictable monthly invoices. SOW amendment + short MAP (mutual action plan) required.

3) Dedicated mini-pool (reserved): best for sustained elevated traffic beyond 3 months; requires procurement lead time and a monthly commit.

Co-term path: we can pro-rate the unused monthly portion to align the added capacity with your Mar 31 2028 renewal date. For the 3-month pilot we typically offer a 10-15% pilot discount with the option to convert to a reserved commit at renewal.

I attached a quick estimate workbook (initial_estimate_dk.xlsx) with cost scenarios (low/med/high spike). If you want, Ben can scope the exact throughput and recommend instance sizing.

If tomorrow works, I can do 10:30am PT.

Cheers,
David

Anna — quick technical note ahead of the sync.

If your traffic is sustained at the 3.5-4x level, two practical approaches:
- Reserved mini-pool: 2x-4x the current pool depending on concurrency. Pros: predictable latency and lower per-token costs. Cons: longer provisioning (3-5 business days) and procurement signoff.
- On-demand burst + KV-prefix caching: immediate with minimal infra changes; works best if spikes are predictable and short. Slightly higher token cost but zero infra lead time.

Pre-reqs for an accurate sizing:
- Sample 24-hour API trace (anonymized) or a 48-hour tps distribution
- Target p50/p95 latency SLOs for the pilot

Pricing note: I put conservative numbers in capacity_options_benc.md (attached). For a 3-month pilot, we can ladder 12% discount at >40% uplift, 15% at >70% uplift if you commit to convert half to a reserved pool at renewal (Mar 31 2028).

Happy to cover the sizing on the call.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
